title: Thresholded Gradient Scaler with Tenant Isolation Constraints
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a new autoscaling policy plugin (Thresholded Gradient Scaler) for Dedicated fleets. The policy uses smoothed gradient estimates of the target metric (e.g., p95 request latency and per-tenant effective throughput) combined with quantile-based thresholds to compute scaling steps. It enforces tenant isolation constraints (per-tenant min/max capacity and burst credits) and fleet-wide safety fences (max step, cool-down windows, and emergency floor). Goal: provide predictable latency SLO adherence while limiting cross-tenant noisy-neighbor amplification and cost spikes.
acceptance_criteria: Policy computes scale decisions every evaluation window and outputs integer replica delta
Per-tenant constraints respected: min_capacity, max_capacity, burst_credit consumption logged
No more than configured max_step replicas added or removed in any single decision
Cooldown honored: policy must not issue scale decisions for the same tenant more than once within cooldown_seconds unless emergency trigger fired
End-to-end integration tests covering steady growth, sudden spike, and noisy-tenant scenarios pass
Performance budget: policy evaluation latency < 120ms at 1k tenants
Feature gated and can be toggled via runtime flag and per-customer rollout config
implementation_notes: Evaluation window: 30s sliding window with exponential smoothing alpha=0.25 by default
Gradient estimate uses median-of-derivatives across 3 sub-windows to be robust to outliers
Quantile targets configurable per-route: default target p95_latency_ms=150ms
Scale delta formula: delta = clamp(round(k * gradient), -max_step, +max_step) where k is adaptive gain based on recent reliability
Tenant isolation: maintain per-tenant credit bucket (tokens) that allow temporary override up to burst_capacity; credits refill at rate proportional to reserved_capacity
Emergency floor: keep a minimum fleet capacity computed from 99th percentile historical baseline to avoid complete underscaling during noisy telemetry
Observability: emit decision::reason label, pre/post metrics snapshot, and decision hash for replayability
API: expose debug endpoint /policy/thresholded-gradient/preview?tenant_id=... returning proposed deltas and contributing signals

2026-03-11 Connor Lee: Prototype evaluator implemented (single-tenant) and smoke-tested against synthetic workload generator. Observed oscillation when max_step=10; lowered default to 3. Added median-of-derivatives to reduce spike sensitivity.
2026-03-12 PM review (Diego Morales): Requested clearer opt-in rollout strategy per-customer and a mechanism to tie policy aggressiveness to reserved committed capacity. Added to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-12 SRE review (Leena Gupta): Raised concern about credit-bucket refill rate causing capacity debt if many tenants simultaneously exhaust bursts. Suggested a global headroom limiter; added emergency floor note.
2026-03-13 Design review (Maya Thompson): UX asks — admin console should show per-tenant burst credit meter and historical decision timeline. Added observability hooks and debug endpoint.

2026-03-14 Connor Lee: Integration test harness extended to multi-tenant mode (200 tenants). Found performance regression in decision eval path; submitted PR #7132 for async batching of metric reads. See attachments for PR link.

2026-03-14 Aisha Patel: Marking blockers: need SLO on policy eval latency and a guardrail in case metric backfill causes large gradients — propose saturating gradient by median absolute deviation (MAD) cap.
